features: High Quality Painting-Peacock tea cup set with a sculpted handle shaped like peacock with gold-trimmed wings and beak while the matching saucer has the exquisite flowing sculpted feather. This novelty coffee cup and saucer set that will bring glamour and sparkle to any space.
Multi-Use-The gorgeous peacock bird tea cup with saucer and spoon can be used both for high tea service and for collection. It's also a great decoration to your dining room, living room or kitchen.

Safety & Durable-This coffee cup is made of high temperature resistant ceramic clay,so it's dishwasher safe. Peacock tea cup set is perfect for most beverages including coffee, tea, chocolate, milk or even cookies.(Not for microwave)
Perfect Gift- Hand crafted tea coffee cup set is a great gift idea for Mom, birthday, housewarming, wedding, anniversary, valentine's, thanksgiving, Christmas or any occasion.
Package Include- You will receive a 180 ML/6 OZ coffee cup, a saucers and a spoon.
description: Features:  Bring the effortless elegance and beauty of the peacock into your kitchen with the Enamel Peacock Cup Set.  Made from porcelain of the highest quality and hand painted with vivid and durable enamel colors of the utmost delicacy, the cup set is both a showpiece of traditional Chinese craftsmanship and a modern functional product.  The set includes a matching teacup, saucer, and spoon, and when assembled, takes the appearance of a peacock, with its slender neck, graceful body and vibrant feathers.  The peacock cup will surely enlighten your home, and make your afternoon coffee time more enjoyable and fashionable.  Package Includes:  1 x Teacup  1 x Saucer  1 x Spoon
